title: Executar testes com pytest
code:
python -m pip install pytest pytest-django
pytest
pytest quartos/tests/test_quartos.py -v
description: pytest executa testes; pytest-django integra o Django e disponibiliza fixtures. Configure DJANGO_SETTINGS_MODULE em pytest.ini.
explanation: pytest executa testes; pytest-django integra o Django e disponibiliza fixtures. Configure DJANGO_SETTINGS_MODULE em pytest.ini.
